story.text: A narrative walk is any sequence of nodes connected by narrative-flow edges that share the same flow reference “#”.

A [[Narrative Path]] is the *simple* (no repeated nodes) version of that walk. In short: a narrative path is the linear story you get by following one labeled narrative flow through distinct topic nodes.
